The impact of group enumeration is primarily reconnaissance. Successful discovery allows an attacker to identify high-privilege users or security groups, facilitating subsequent phases of an attack such as credential harvesting or privilege escalation.

## Recommendation

Deploy the provided Sigma detection rule to monitor process executions involving sensitive group files or enumeration tools. Because these utilities are heavily used for legitimate system administration, focus analysis on deviations from established administrative baselines or account behavior.

objects.name: Zohocorp ManageEngine Eventlog Analyzer and Log360: Authenticated remote code execution (CVE-2026-8923)
objects.description:
## Overview
Zohocorp ManageEngine Eventlog Analyzer and ManageEngine Log360 versions before 13062 are vulnerable to authenticated remote code execution (RCE) via the Log Forwarding configuration option. An attacker with valid credentials can leverage this feature to execute arbitrary code on the underlying host system.

## Impact
Successful exploitation allows an authenticated user to achieve remote code execution on the server hosting the ManageEngine application, potentially leading to full system compromise.

## Recommendation
- Upgrade ManageEngine Eventlog Analyzer and ManageEngine Log360 to version 13062 or later immediately.
- Audit existing ManageEngine administrative accounts and restrict access to the Log Forwarding configuration interface to verified administrators only.
- Review historical logs for any unusual modifications to log forwarding settings or suspicious process execution spawning from the ManageEngine service account.

objects.name: HotGo: Authentication bypass vulnerability (CVE-2026-120447)
objects.description:
## Overview

HotGo through version 2.15.1 is affected by an authentication bypass vulnerability. An attacker can manipulate the SMS login process by supplying a user-defined value in the Code field during a request to the /admin/sms/send endpoint. By knowing a target user's mobile number, an attacker can set a known verification code and subsequently authenticate through the /admin/site/mobileLogin endpoint to compromise the account.

## Impact

Successful exploitation allows unauthenticated attackers to gain unauthorized access to any user account, including those with administrative privileges, resulting in full account takeover.

## Recommendation

Identify all HotGo deployments within the environment. As of this report, no specific patch version is listed, but users should monitor the vendor for a security update to address CVE-2026-120447 and apply it immediately upon release.

objects.name: PostgreSQL: psqlODBC memory corruption vulnerability (CVE-2026-120064)
objects.description:
Several psqlODBC entry points use application-supplied column numbers or row indexes as array indexes without validation. 
- `SQLBindCol` with a column number above 32767 can cause the binding count to wrap negative, leading to out-of-bounds array access.
- Negative `SQL_DESC_COUNT` on an application row descriptor results in unbinding columns at negative indexes.
- `SQLColAttribute` with a large column number can use a negative index.
- `SQLSetPos(SQL_ADD)` fails to validate the row number against the rowset size.
An application that forwards untrusted column or row numbers exposes its process to out-of-bounds reads and writes. Versions before psqlODBC 18.00.0006 are affected.

objects.name: Traefik: Multiple security control bypass vulnerabilities
objects.description:
## Overview
The German Federal Office for Information Security (BSI) has released an advisory regarding multiple vulnerabilities in Traefik that allow for the bypass of security mechanisms. No specific CVE IDs or technical exploit details have been disclosed in this initial advisory. Organizations using Traefik are advised to monitor for official vendor patches and technical updates from Traefik Labs.

## Recommendation
- Inventory all internet-facing and internal Traefik proxy deployments.
- Monitor the Traefik Labs security advisory portal for pending release information and patch availability.
- Implement strict ingress filtering and review access logs for anomalous traffic patterns directed at the proxy infrastructure.

objects.name: Linksys E8450: Stack-based buffer overflow in portal.cgi (CVE-2026-120283)
objects.description: A vulnerability was identified in Linksys E8450 firmware version 1.2.00.360516. The issue involves the `strcpy` function in the file `/www/cgi-bin/portal.cgi`. Manipulation of the `hidden_timezone` argument leads to a stack-based buffer overflow. The attack can be executed remotely. The vendor was contacted regarding this disclosure but did not respond.

objects.name: Modem: Out-of-bounds write vulnerability (CVE-2026-20499)
objects.description:
## Overview

CVE-2026-20499 is a memory corruption vulnerability in Modem firmware identified by the lack of bounds checking. The vulnerability allows for remote privilege escalation when a User Equipment (UE) device connects to a rogue base station controlled by an attacker. The vulnerability (MSV-8247) is addressed by Patch ID MOLY01857954.

## Impact

An attacker can achieve remote privilege escalation on a target device without user interaction or prior elevated execution privileges by forcing the device to connect to a malicious base station.

## Recommendation

* Verify the current firmware version of all cellular-connected UEs in the environment.
* Apply patch MOLY01857954 (Issue MSV-8247) to all affected Modem hardware.
* Implement cellular network monitoring to identify anomalies in base station parameters or signal strength characteristics that may indicate rogue base station activity.

objects.name: Control Web Panel: OS command injection in protected_directory (CVE-2026-77876)
objects.description: Control Web Panel (CWP) before webpanel_version 1.16 contains an OS command injection vulnerability in the protected_directory user panel module. The flaw allows attackers to execute arbitrary commands by submitting unescaped input through the 'file' POST parameter in the 'acc=deletedp' action. This occurs because the application passes attacker-controlled input directly into a shell_exec call, allowing code execution in the user panel context.

objects.name: DoraCMS: Mass assignment in user API key management (CVE-2026-120448)
objects.description:
## Overview
DoraCMS through version 3.1.0 contains a mass assignment vulnerability in the PUT /api/v1/user/api-keys/:id endpoint. An authenticated, low-privileged user can manipulate the 'userId' field in a PUT request to associate their own API key with a victim's account. This allows the attacker to impersonate the victim, enabling unauthorized modifications to profiles, content publication, and content deletion.

## Impact
Successful exploitation grants an attacker the privileges of a targeted user, which may include administrative rights depending on the victim's account level. This allows for unauthorized profile changes, as well as the deletion or modification of content within the DoraCMS instance.

## Recommendation
- Update DoraCMS to the latest available version containing the patch for CVE-2026-120448.
- Review web server access logs for anomalous PUT requests directed at the /api/v1/user/api-keys/ endpoint.
- Audit existing API key ownership and monitor for unexpected changes in key-to-user mappings.

objects.name: Barracuda Networks: Pre-authentication Authorization Bypass and Command Injection
objects.description:
## Overview

Barracuda Networks has disclosed multiple security vulnerabilities affecting a wide range of its appliance products. The vulnerabilities are identified as pre-authentication authorization bypass and command injection. Unauthenticated remote attackers may be able to bypass security controls or execute arbitrary system commands on the affected devices. 

## Recommendation

Prioritize patching of all internet-facing Barracuda appliances to the following minimum versions:

* Barracuda Email Security Gateway (ESG): Update to 9.4.0.030 or later.
* Barracuda Load Balancer ADC: Update to 6.4.0 or later.
* Barracuda Web Application Firewall (WAF): Update to 11.0.1 or later.
* Barracuda Web Security Gateway (WSG): Update to 16.1.100.100 or later.
* Barracuda Message Archiver (BMA): Update to 5.5.4.0 or later.
* Barracuda WAF Control Center (WCC): Update to 2.2.1 or later.

Administrators should monitor appliance audit logs for unusual management interface access attempts or unexpected process execution spawned by web service accounts.

objects.name: Krill: Authentication bypass in RPKI provisioning (CVE-2026-109142)
objects.description: CVE-2026-109142 is an authentication bypass vulnerability in Krill. When a CA's parent lives on the same Krill server, the system fails to verify that the child identity (child_handle) belongs to the CA making the request. Instead, it runs the RFC 6492 provisioning exchange in-process and trusts the child identity provided by the caller in the parent contact.

objects.name: Linux Kernel: io_uring waitid reference counter wrap (CVE-2026-99227)
objects.description: The Linux kernel io_uring/waitid implementation packs cancellation state into bit 31 of a reference counter, using the remaining bits as a 31-bit reference counter. Repeated failed cancellation attempts incorrectly increment the reference counter, which can lead to a wrap-around to zero. This state allows a subsequent cancellation attempt to claim ownership and complete the request a second time.

objects.name: FluentCart: Arbitrary file deletion (CVE-2026-120577)
objects.description:
## Overview
The FluentCart plugin for WordPress (versions 1.6.2 and earlier) is susceptible to an arbitrary file deletion vulnerability. This flaw stems from improper file path validation within the plugin's `deleteFile` function. Authenticated users with custom-level access or higher can leverage this vulnerability to delete critical files on the web server, such as `wp-config.php`, which can result in application compromise or remote code execution.

## Impact
Successful exploitation allows for the deletion of arbitrary files on the hosting server. Deleting critical application configuration files, such as `wp-config.php`, may force the application into an installation state or facilitate further exploitation leading to remote code execution.

## Recommendation
- Update the FluentCart plugin to the latest available version (beyond 1.6.2) to remediate the path validation flaw.
- Review WordPress user role assignments to ensure that users with custom-level access and above are limited to trusted individuals.
- Audit web server file access logs for requests targeting the `deleteFile` function logic, typically associated with administrative or plugin-specific API endpoints.

objects.name: OpenAirInterface Core Network: Stack-based buffer overflow in UDM (CVE-2026-106808)
objects.description: A stack-based buffer overflow vulnerability exists in OpenAirInterface (OAI) Core Network v2.2.1 within the Nudm_UEAU Generate Authentication Data endpoint. The UDM fails to validate the size of `resynchronizationInfo.rand` and `auts` values when passed to `conv::hex_str_to_uint8()`. An unauthenticated attacker with access to the SBI interface and a valid SUPI can provide an oversized value to overwrite adjacent stack memory and the stack canary, causing the UDM process to terminate.

objects.name: JetBrains Toolbox App and IntelliJ IDEA: Security bypass vulnerability
objects.description:
## Overview

The BSI has released an advisory regarding a security vulnerability in JetBrains Toolbox App and IntelliJ IDEA. A remote, unauthenticated attacker can exploit this flaw to bypass security controls within the affected applications. No specific CVE identifier or exploitation details have been disclosed at this time. 

## Recommendation

- Inventory all installations of JetBrains Toolbox App and IntelliJ IDEA across the organization.
- Monitor vendor advisory channels for patch availability and specific update instructions from JetBrains.
- Prioritize applying security updates immediately upon release by the vendor to address this bypass vulnerability.

objects.name: SureCart: Unauthenticated account takeover vulnerability (CVE-2026-120574)
objects.description: The SureCart plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to unauthenticated account takeover in all versions up to, and including, 4.9.5. The passwordless one-time-code login REST route (VerificationCodeController::verify()) resolves an attacker-supplied login to any WordPress user, verifies a 6-digit code, and calls wp_set_auth_cookie() for that user. This path lacks per-account attempt counters, persistent email/IP lockout, or rate limits. An unauthenticated attacker can trigger a code for any user via a companion endpoint and brute-force the 6-digit code to obtain an authenticated session as that user, resulting in a full administrator account takeover.

objects.name: Control Web Panel: Authentication bypass via execution after redirect (CVE-2026-73696)
objects.description:
## Overview

Control Web Panel (CWP) versions before 1.12 are vulnerable to an execution after redirect flaw within the user panel authentication process. The unauthenticatedFlow() function in CWPUserIndex initiates a redirect to the login page via toLoginWithIntendedUri() but fails to call exit(), which allows the PHP script execution to proceed. This flaw permits an attacker with a valid hosting username to reach module code paths that should be restricted, potentially leading to unauthorized access and privilege escalation.

## Impact

Successful exploitation allows unauthenticated users with a valid hosting account to bypass security controls and interact with internal user-panel modules, which can facilitate a chain of exploitation leading to root-level compromise of the server.

## Recommendation

Update all Control Web Panel instances to version 1.12 or later immediately to address the vulnerable authentication logic.

objects.name: Azure Resource Manager: Unauthorized resource group deletion detection
objects.description:
## Overview
Azure Resource Group deletion is a permanent operation that removes all contained resources. Attackers may leverage this to perform data destruction, impair recovery by removing snapshots or backups, or cause operational disruption. This detection uses an ES|QL first-seen approach to alert on resource group deletions performed by principals that have not executed this action in the preceding 7 days, helping to filter routine infrastructure-as-code or CI/CD activity while flagging anomalous identity behavior.

## Impact
Deletion of a resource group is irreversible and removes all resources within it. Observed impact can range from authorized environment teardown by automated pipelines to unauthorized destruction of production infrastructure or defensive evasion by clearing logs and supporting resources.

## Recommendation
- Deploy the ES|QL detection logic provided by Elastic to flag first-time resource group deletions.
- Establish a baseline of known CI/CD, IaC, and platform service principals and investigate any alerts triggered by identities outside this scope.
- Implement Azure Policy or management locks on critical production resource groups to prevent accidental or unauthorized deletion.
- Require privileged delete operations to proceed via Privileged Identity Management (PIM) or approved change-control pipelines.

objects.name: PyMuPDF: Stack-based buffer overflow in JM_set_annot_callout_line (CVE-2026-120752)
objects.description:
## Overview

PyMuPDF versions before 2.0 contain a stack-based buffer overflow vulnerability in the function JM_set_annot_callout_line. The function fails to validate the number of callout points supplied by the caller, copying them into a fixed three-element stack array. An attacker controlling the callout argument passed to the Page.add_freetext_annot method can provide four or more points to overwrite the stack frame. Successful exploitation may result in a crash of the host process or arbitrary code execution.

## Impact

Successful exploitation allows for memory corruption within the application process, leading to denial of service via process crash or potential arbitrary code execution under the context of the user or service running the PyMuPDF library.

## Recommendation

Upgrade all instances of PyMuPDF to version 2.0 or later immediately to incorporate the bounds checking fix for the JM_set_annot_callout_line function. Perform an inventory of internal applications and third-party software that utilize the PyMuPDF library to identify instances requiring updates.

objects.name: Grafana Mimir and Enterprise Metrics: Alertmanager arbitrary file read (CVE-2026-81938)
objects.description: Grafana Mimir's Alertmanager does not properly validate tenant-supplied receiver configurations that reference local files. Specifically, the `http_headers.<name>.files` and `basic_auth.username_file` settings allow a tenant to point to any file readable by the Alertmanager process. When a notification is sent, Alertmanager reads the file and includes its contents in a header of the outgoing request. By directing the receiver to an attacker-controlled server, the tenant can exfiltrate sensitive files, such as credentials and configuration, from the host.

objects.name: SD-JWT JS: Disclosure omission and validation bypass (CVE-2026-62374)
objects.description:
The `@sd-jwt/decode` and `@sd-jwt/core` libraries (version 0.19.0) contain a validation flaw in the disclosure processing layer that deviates from RFC 9901 requirements. The libraries perform a lossy decoding process that silently drops tampered or non-decodable disclosures instead of rejecting the presentation.

When a disclosure is tampered with (e.g., via byte manipulation or invalid UTF-8 sequences), the library fails to identify the mismatch against the Issuer-signed `_sd` array. Consequently, the library returns a successful verification result containing a reduced claim set. This behavior acts as an omission primitive, potentially allowing holders or on-path attackers to bypass authorization logic that assumes the presence of specific credentials.

The issue specifically violates:
- RFC 9901 §7.1 step 5: Mandatory rejection if any disclosure is not referenced by digest in the signed JWT.
- RFC 9901 §7.1 step 3 / §4.2.1: Mandatory rejection of non-base64url-JSON disclosures.

objects.name: Petpooja Munshi: Payment bypass vulnerability (CVE-2026-119731)
objects.description: Munshi (by Petpooja) before 2026-06-30 contained a payment bypass vulnerability in its subscription payment webhook at POST /api/payment/order/webhook. The endpoint lacks webhook authentication, cryptographic signature verification, source validation, and independent server-side confirmation with the payment provider. A remote, unauthenticated attacker can submit a forged payment-success notification referencing an order obtained from the payment-status redirect URL, causing the backend to mark the subscription as paid/active and granting paid access without an actual successful payment.

objects.name: TraderTraitor: Large-scale cryptocurrency theft targeting Binance
objects.description:
## Overview

The U.S. Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI) has attributed a record $6.43 billion cryptocurrency theft from Binance to the North Korea-aligned threat actor TraderTraitor (also known as Jade Sleet, Pressure Chollima, PUKCHONG, Slow Pisces, and UNC4899). The threat actor is known to target individuals in the cybersecurity, AI, and blockchain industries using AI-generated personas and job-themed lures. The group leverages trojanized Terraform providers to deliver a Bash loader, which subsequently installs the FLATROOF cross-platform implant and the ROOFDECK backdoor.

## Attack Chain

1. **Reconnaissance:** The actor identifies targets in the cybersecurity, AI, and blockchain sectors.
2. **Social Engineering:** The actor poses as recruiters using AI-generated personas and industry-specific knowledge to schedule interviews via spoofed front companies.
3. **Delivery:** The target is convinced to download or interact with malicious resources, including trojanized Terraform providers.
4. **Execution:** The Terraform provider executes a Bash loader script.
5. **Staging:** The loader identifies the victim's OS and downloads the appropriate implant (FLATROOF).
6. **Persistence & Control:** The FLATROOF implant exfiltrates data and drops the ROOFDECK backdoor to establish remote command and control.
7. **Exploitation:** The actor utilizes the compromised environment to facilitate the theft and subsequent laundering of virtual assets.

## Impact

- Over $6.43 billion in virtual assets stolen from Binance, the largest cryptocurrency theft in history.
- Approximately $2.85 billion in stolen assets has been frozen on-chain by various entities including Tether, Circle, Ripple, Arbitrum, and Optimism.

## Recommendation

- Implement strict code review processes for any third-party infrastructure-as-code (IaC) modules, specifically Terraform providers.
- Audit outbound network connections from build servers and developer workstations to prevent unexpected downloads of loaders from untrusted external sources.
- Implement endpoint security monitoring to detect the execution of suspicious Bash scripts, Python information stealers, and the specific artifacts associated with FLATROOF and ROOFDECK implants.
- Review recruitment and hiring practices to verify the identity of external recruiters and the legitimacy of job opportunities offered via social media or professional networks.

objects.name: madong-admin-saas: Missing authentication in tenant management API (CVE-2026-120446)
objects.description:
## Overview

CVE-2026-120446 is a critical authentication bypass vulnerability in the 'madong-admin-saas' platform. The flaw originates from a middleware configuration error where the 'platformapi' key fails to validate against the 'platform' application, effectively disabling authentication for specific API endpoints. Unauthenticated attackers can access, modify, or delete tenant accounts and subscription plans by interacting directly with the exposed API.

## Impact

Successful exploitation allows unauthenticated remote attackers to list, create, modify, disable, or delete tenants, and modify subscription plans via the platform tenant management API.

## Recommendation

1. Inventory all instances of 'madong-admin-saas' running version 5.1.4 or earlier.
2. Prioritize upgrading to the latest patched version of the software.
3. If immediate patching is not possible, apply network access control lists (ACLs) to restrict access to the /platformapi/ endpoints to known-trusted management IP ranges.
4. Implement logging for all requests to the /platformapi/tenant/account, bind-plan, and sync-data endpoints to identify unauthorized access attempts.

objects.name: GoFound: Path traversal arbitrary directory deletion (CVE-2026-120444)
objects.description:
## Overview

GoFound through version 1.4.1 contains a path traversal vulnerability in the database parameter. An unauthenticated attacker can exploit this via crafted GET requests to the /api/db/create and /api/db/drop endpoints. By injecting dot-dot-slash (../) sequences into the parameter, the application performs an os.RemoveAll operation on directories outside the intended data directory, leading to arbitrary directory deletion.

## Impact

Successful exploitation allows unauthenticated attackers to delete arbitrary directories on the server hosting the GoFound application, potentially resulting in system instability, data loss, or denial of service depending on the target path.

## Recommendation

- Upgrade GoFound to a version beyond 1.4.1 once a security update is released by the maintainers.
- Audit access logs for requests to /api/db/create and /api/db/drop containing path traversal characters.
- Restrict network access to the GoFound API management endpoints to authorized management IP addresses only.

objects.name: Linux Kernel: Bluetooth L2CAP Race Condition (CVE-2026-99239)
objects.description: A vulnerability exists in the Linux kernel Bluetooth stack where a TOCTOU race condition allows an l2cap_chan to be linked to an l2cap_conn multiple times. This violates an invariant assumed by cleanup functions such as l2cap_chan_del. The vulnerability occurs because l2cap_sock_connect does not check sk->sk_state, potentially triggering a second __l2cap_chan_add call. The fix includes an invariant check in __l2cap_chan_add and introduces locking in l2cap_sock_bind to protect the channel state.

objects.name: Netpbm: Heap-based buffer overflow in sgitopnm (CVE-2026-120431)
objects.description:
## Overview
Netpbm versions before 10.86.51, 11.x before 11.02.29, and 11.03 before 11.15.07 are affected by a heap-based buffer overflow vulnerability in the `sgitopnm` utility. The flaw exists within the `readChannels()` function and is triggered when processing RLE-compressed SGI images containing an oversized offset table. Successful exploitation can result in application crashes or arbitrary code execution.

## Impact
Successful exploitation may lead to a crash of the `sgitopnm` utility (Denial of Service) or arbitrary code execution in the context of the user executing the tool.

## Recommendation
- Inventory all systems utilizing Netpbm or libraries relying on `sgitopnm`.
- Update Netpbm to version 10.86.51, 11.02.29, 11.15.07, or later to address the vulnerability.
- Implement file integrity monitoring for high-risk input processing pipelines that utilize legacy image processing libraries.

objects.name: AWS EC2 Bulk User Data Enumeration
objects.description:
## Overview
The Elastic detection rule monitors AWS CloudTrail logs for the 'DescribeInstanceAttribute' API action when the 'userData' attribute is requested. Bulk enumeration of this attribute is a high-risk activity, as instance user data often contains sensitive bootstrap scripts, hardcoded credentials, or API tokens. The rule triggers when a single principal, identified by ARN and source IP, accesses this attribute for more than 20 distinct EC2 instances in a 10-minute lookback period.

## Impact
Unauthorized access to EC2 user data can lead to the exposure of plain-text secrets, environment-specific configuration tokens, and infrastructure-level credentials, facilitating further privilege escalation or lateral movement within the cloud environment.

## Recommendation
- Deploy the provided Elastic detection logic to monitor CloudTrail for bulk 'DescribeInstanceAttribute' calls.
- Review alerts triggered by this rule for unauthorized principals, particularly those originating from unexpected ASNs or non-standard user agents.
- Investigate the retrieved 'instanceId' values to determine if sensitive production workloads are targeted.
- Implement a policy of least privilege, restricting 'ec2:DescribeInstanceAttribute' access to only those roles that require it for operational health or inventory management.
- Audit existing instance user data and migrate sensitive secrets to dedicated solutions such as AWS Secrets Manager or Systems Manager Parameter Store.

objects.name: Camaleon CMS: Missing authorization in MediaController (CVE-2026-120429)
objects.description:
## Overview
Camaleon CMS versions before 2.9.2 contain a missing authorization vulnerability within the `Admin::MediaController`. This flaw allows authenticated users with low privileges to bypass role-based permission checks. An attacker can exploit this to upload arbitrary files, access private media files via `download_private_file`, and manipulate other users' avatars by calling the `crop` function with `saved_avatar`.

## Impact
Successful exploitation allows low-privileged users to read sensitive private media files, perform unauthorized file uploads, and perform account-level modification by altering user avatars.

## Recommendation
- Upgrade Camaleon CMS to version 2.9.2 or later to apply the authorization checks for media management.
- Audit administrative media logs for unexpected file uploads or avatar modifications performed by low-privileged user accounts.

objects.name: Zoho ManageEngine Password Manager Pro and PAM360 Remote Code Execution (CVE-2026-18199)
objects.description: Zohocorp ManageEngine Password Manager Pro versions before 13236 and PAM360 versions before 8601 are vulnerable to an authenticated Remote Code Execution vulnerability.

objects.name: GitHub: Disabling Dependabot alerts and security updates
objects.description:
## Overview
GitHub audit logs capture events where Dependabot alerts or automated security updates are disabled. This activity is a potential indicator of defense evasion, as it prevents GitHub from flagging malicious or vulnerable packages. Depending on the scope of the configuration change, an actor can remove automated security coverage from a single repository, an entire organization, or an enterprise environment. This often precedes the injection of malicious code or dependency tampering.

## Impact
Disabling Dependabot removes automated visibility into vulnerable and malicious packages, increasing the likelihood that supply-chain compromises go undetected by security tooling.

## Recommendation
- Monitor GitHub audit logs for the specific `disable` actions listed in the detection guidance below.
- Audit administrative access and programmatic tokens that have permissions to modify organization or enterprise security settings.
- Review repository commits and dependency manifest changes (e.g., package.json, go.mod, requirements.txt) occurring immediately before or after these disable events.
- Re-enable Dependabot features unless a documented and approved exception exists.

objects.name: Fastify: Path restriction bypass in @fastify/http-proxy (CVE-2026-120213)
objects.description:
## Overview

The @fastify/http-proxy plugin, versions 9.0.0 through 11.6.5, contains a path-restriction bypass vulnerability. When the plugin is configured with parameterized prefix and rewritePrefix options, it fails to correctly re-encode URL-decoded parameters before they are used in the upstream proxy path. An attacker can inject URL-encoded path separators (e.g., %2f) or query delimiters that decode into active separators on the server, allowing the proxy to direct requests to unintended upstream endpoints. This flaw enables SSRF and authorization bypass in backend services that rely on the proxy to enforce path constraints.

## Impact

The vulnerability allows unauthenticated remote attackers to reach upstream locations outside the intended prefix. Observed impacts include path-restriction bypass, server-side request forgery (SSRF), and potential authorization bypass in the proxied service.

## Recommendation

Upgrade @fastify/http-proxy to version 11.6.6 or later immediately. There are no available workarounds; patching is required to address the injection flaw.

objects.name: Tenable Identity Exposure: Multiple vulnerabilities (CVE-2026-119314, CVE-2026-119315, CVE-2026-119316)
objects.description:
## Overview

Tenable has released security bulletin tns-2026-34 addressing multiple vulnerabilities in Tenable Identity Exposure. These flaws can be leveraged by a remote attacker to execute arbitrary code, perform a denial-of-service, or gain unauthorized access to sensitive data. The identified CVEs include CVE-2026-119314, CVE-2026-119315, and CVE-2026-119316. 

## Impact

Successful exploitation may result in remote code execution, remote denial-of-service, or the compromise of data confidentiality within the affected Tenable Identity Exposure environment.

## Recommendation

Identify and patch all instances of Tenable Identity Exposure. Upgrade to the versions specified in the Tenable security bulletin tns-2026-34 (specifically version 3.77.18 or higher for 3.x branches earlier than 3.77.18, and 3.93.6 or higher for 3.x branches earlier than 3.93.6).

objects.name: Advanced Custom Fields: Extended PRO: Limited Code Injection (CVE-2026-120534)
objects.description:
## Overview
CVE-2026-120534 identifies a vulnerability in Advanced Custom Fields: Extended PRO for WordPress in all versions up to, and including, 0.9.2.6. The flaw exists in the 'render_field' function due to insufficient validation of form configuration parameters before they are merged into field settings and passed to 'call_user_func_array'. 

This vulnerability allows unauthenticated attackers to call arbitrary WordPress functions with controlled arguments, contingent on specific conditions:
1. The administrator has enabled the non-default 'shortcode_preview' setting for the target form.
2. The server environment lacks OpenSSL functions, causing 'acf_decrypt' to fall back to unverified base64 decoding.

objects.name: Siemens SIMATIC IoT2050 Advanced: Node-RED Authentication Bypass (CVE-2026-58115)
objects.description: A public exploit for CVE-2026-58115 has been published on Sploitus. The vulnerability, which carries a CVSS score of 10.0, stems from a lack of authentication in the Node-RED HTTP interface. On affected Siemens SIMATIC IoT2050 Advanced gateways, this allows unauthenticated remote attackers to execute arbitrary shell commands. VulnCheck observed in-the-wild exploitation beginning on October 30, 2026, involving the deployment of malicious flows, Linux bot binaries, and persistent webshells.

objects.name: Zyxel GS1900-24E: Out-of-bounds write vulnerability (CVE-2026-107441)
objects.description: An out-of-bounds write vulnerability exists in the CGI program of Zyxel GS1900-24E firmware versions through 2.90(AAHK.2)C0. This flaw may allow an unauthenticated adjacent attacker to potentially execute OS commands via a crafted HTTP request. The vulnerability is identified as CVE-2026-107441 with a CVSS v3.1 base score of 8.8.

objects.name: SUSE Rancher Meta Proxy Allowlist Bypass SSRF
objects.description:
## Overview
A security vulnerability exists in SUSE Rancher, specifically within its meta proxy component, which allows for an allowlist bypass. This vulnerability can lead to server-side request forgery (SSRF), potentially enabling attackers to make unauthorized requests to internal resources that should be restricted. Administrators should apply the provided updates immediately.

## Recommendation
- Update Rancher instances to the following patched versions to address the meta proxy allowlist bypass:
 - 2.11.19
 - 2.12.15
 - 2.13.11
 - 2.14.7
 - 2.15.3
- Review Rancher logs for anomalous outbound HTTP requests originating from the cluster management API or proxy components.

objects.name: SentinelOne: Context menu scan command registry modification
objects.description:
## Overview
The SentinelOne context menu scan command can be tampered with by unauthorized processes. By modifying the Windows registry keys associated with the SentinelOne shell context menu, a process other than SentinelOne may alter the command executed when the scan action is triggered.

## Recommendation
- Monitor for unauthorized modifications to the SentinelOne context menu registry keys using the provided detection logic.
- Investigate any processes, other than authorized Sentinel Agent binaries, that write to the registry subkeys under '\shell\SentinelOneScan\command\'.

objects.name: System Network Connections Discovery - Linux
objects.description:
Adversaries may use tools such as netstat, ss, lsof, or sockstat to enumerate active connections, open ports, and listening services on a compromised system. 

Legitimate administration activities may also utilize these utilities, which can result in false positives.

objects.name: Fortinet FortiWeb: Unauthenticated SQL injection leading to remote code execution (CVE-2025-25257)
objects.description:
## Overview
Fortinet FortiWeb is affected by a critical vulnerability (CVE-2025-25257) that enables unauthenticated SQL injection, which can be leveraged to achieve remote code execution. Proof-of-concept exploitation code is publicly available, allowing for identification and potential compromise of unpatched systems. Patches are available in FortiWeb versions 7.0.11, 7.2.11, 7.4.8, and 7.6.4.

## Impact
Successful exploitation allows an unauthenticated, remote attacker to execute arbitrary code on the target appliance with full system impact (CVSS 9.8).

## Recommendation
- Upgrade all FortiWeb instances to the patched versions immediately: 7.0.11, 7.2.11, 7.4.8, or 7.6.4.
- Review network logs for requests to the FortiWeb appliance containing unusual SQL patterns or shell command sequences.
- Restrict access to the management interface of FortiWeb to known, trusted administrative IP addresses.

objects.name: Gitea: Archived repository metadata authorization bypass (CVE-2026-116296)
objects.description:
## Overview
Gitea repositories configured as "archived" are intended to be permanently read-only. However, due to a missing authorization check (CWE-862) in the API middleware, users with write-collaborator access can bypass these restrictions. While previous security patches (PR #39839) secured Issues and Wikis, the API routes for Milestones, Releases, and Labels remained unprotected. This vulnerability is fixed in Gitea v28.2.1.

## Impact
Users with write-collaborator privileges can tamper with historical project data, including deleting or modifying milestones and releases, which compromises the integrity of repositories intended to serve as audit-grade snapshots.

## Recommendation
- Upgrade all Gitea instances running versions <= v28.2.0 to v28.2.1 or later.
- Audit logs for API write activity on repositories marked as archived to identify potential unauthorized modifications.

objects.name: Ruijie Managed Switches: Buffer overflow in firmware upgrade interface (CVE-2026-120241)
objects.description: A vulnerability exists in the httpupg.cgi file within the Local Firmware Upgrade Interface of Ruijie RG-ES205GC, RG-ES206GC-P, RG-ES208GC, RG-ES210GC-LP, and RG-ES210GS-P (version ESW_1.0(1)B1P48). The vulnerability allows for remote buffer overflow. Public exploit code is available. The vendor did not respond to disclosure.

objects.name: Linksys Routers: Remote administrative privilege escalation
objects.description:
## Overview

A critical, unpatched vulnerability has been identified in Linksys routers. The flaw allows a remote, unauthenticated attacker to gain administrator-level privileges. Successful exploitation enables the attacker to perform unauthorized file manipulation, disclose sensitive information, or induce a denial-of-service condition on the affected hardware. No patch or vendor workaround is currently available.

## Impact

The vulnerability provides unauthenticated attackers with administrative access, potentially leading to full compromise of the network gateway, sensitive data exfiltration, service disruption, and persistent unauthorized access to the network infrastructure.

## Recommendation

* Identify all Linksys router devices within the network inventory.
* Restrict management interfaces of these routers to trusted local subnets to prevent remote exploitation.
* Monitor for any unauthorized configuration changes or anomalous traffic originating from or targeting these router management interfaces.
* Subscribe to vendor security advisories and prioritize firmware updates once a patch becomes available.

objects.name: python-jose: Authentication bypass via JWT forgery (CVE-2026-120459)
objects.description:
## Overview

CVE-2026-120459 describes an authentication bypass vulnerability in python-jose versions 3.5.0 and earlier. The flaw exists in the HMACKey and CryptographyHMACKey implementations, which incorrectly accept zero-length HMAC secrets during JWT verification. If an application relies on these methods to verify HS256, HS384, or HS512 tokens and the verification key resolves to an empty value (or an octet JWK with an empty 'k' parameter), an attacker can successfully forge tokens containing arbitrary claims that are accepted by jwt.decode.

## Impact

Successful exploitation allows an unauthenticated attacker to bypass authentication mechanisms and impersonate arbitrary users by forging validly signed JWTs.

## Recommendation

Update to the latest version of python-jose where the fix is implemented. Until an upgrade is possible, audit application code to ensure that HMAC verification keys are strictly validated for non-zero length before being passed to the library.

objects.name: Linux kernel: Use-after-free in tracing subsystem (CVE-2026-99235)
objects.description:
## Overview
The Linux kernel tracing subsystem contains a use-after-free vulnerability (CVE-2026-99235) in `create_field_var_hist()`. The issue occurs because the kernel saves a pointer to a compatible histogram that can be deallocated by a user while a target maintains a reference to it. This leads to a slab-use-after-free condition when the target attempts to access the freed memory.

## Resolution
The vulnerability has been resolved in the Linux kernel by saving the event file instead of the compatible histogram, as the event file persists even when a trigger is removed.

objects.name: NetamLoader: Multi-stage .NET injection malware targeting Windows 10
objects.description:
## Overview
NetamLoader is a sophisticated, previously undocumented .NET assembly-loading framework identified by Kaspersky. The malware targets custom Windows 10 builds (likely Windows 10 China Government Edition) used by government entities in Asia. It achieves code execution through AppDomainManager injection, hijacking the initialization process of legitimate applications. The malware was observed packaged within Windows cabinet (CAB) archives placed in system update directories, suggesting a potential supply chain compromise of trusted third-party software.

## Attack Chain
1. Delivery of a malicious CAB archive to the victim machine, specifically within 'C:\Windows\SoftwareDistribution\Download\' paths.
2. Extraction of contents into 'C:\Windows\SoftwareDistribution\Download\Install\'.
3. Execution of the legitimate process 'PatchMyPC-ScriptRunner.exe', which parses a malicious 'PatchMyPC-ScriptRunner.exe.config' file.
4. Initiation of AppDomainManager injection to load 'Microsoft.HostIntegration.Connectors.dll'.
5. Parsing of 'fabric.config' by the DLL to load the 'Resources.resx' file containing encoded and encrypted payloads.
6. Multi-stage decryption and loading of XAML and .NET modules, including XAML-2-1 for AMSI bypass.
7. Execution of XAML-3 within 'dllhost.exe' and final loading of the .NET 2 Plugin.
8. Deployment of a periodic C2 polling loop to 'openaigpt4v.com' for further payload retrieval and execution in isolated AppDomains.

## Recommendation
- Inventory systems containing Windows 10 China Government Edition or specialized government Windows builds.
- Monitor directory paths 'C:\Windows\SoftwareDistribution\Download\' for the presence of unexpected CAB archives or unauthorized file extractions into 'Install' subdirectories.
- Implement strict process execution policies for 'PatchMyPC-ScriptRunner.exe' and ensure hashes match known legitimate versions from the vendor.
- Block communication with 'openaigpt4v.com' at the network perimeter.
- Audit .NET configuration files (.config) in sensitive directories for unexpected 'AppDomainManager' settings.

objects.name: Citrix NetScaler ADC and Gateway SAML Memory Overflow (CVE-2026-107406)
objects.description: A public exploit is available for CVE-2026-107406, a critical (CVSS 9.5) unauthenticated memory overflow vulnerability (CWE-119) affecting Citrix NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway. The vulnerability resides in the SAML message parser. Successful exploitation can lead to a denial of service (via service crash) or remote code execution.

objects.name: SUSE Rancher Fleet: Privilege Escalation via Unauthorized Kubeconfig Reference (CVE-2026-94290)
objects.description:
## Overview

SUSE Rancher Fleet clusters reference kubeconfig secrets for the deployment and management of agents on target clusters. A vulnerability exists where the controller does not properly validate or restrict which kubeconfig secrets a Fleet Cluster object may reference. An attacker with control over a namespace can configure a Fleet Cluster object to reference administrative kubeconfig secrets belonging to the management cluster. This results in the Fleet controller interacting with the management cluster using these administrative credentials, enabling the attacker to execute arbitrary Fleet content within the management cluster with elevated privileges.

## Impact

Successful exploitation allows for privilege escalation from a namespace-restricted user to administrative control over the management cluster, potentially leading to full cluster compromise.

## Recommendation

- Upgrade Rancher Fleet to a patched version once available from SUSE.
- Audit existing Fleet Cluster objects for suspicious kubeconfig secret references, particularly those pointing to secrets outside of the object's namespace.
- Restrict RBAC permissions for creating or modifying Fleet Cluster objects in non-administrative namespaces.

objects.name: Eclipse Mnestix Browser: Unauthenticated authorization bypass (CVE-2026-89293)
objects.description:
## Overview

CVE-2026-89293 is an authorization bypass vulnerability in the Eclipse Mnestix Browser. Versions 1.2.0 up to, but excluding, 2.3.0 allow unauthenticated attackers to perform actions restricted to authorized users. Specifically, an attacker can modify infrastructure settings or invoke operations on the connected and authenticated Mnestix AAS Generator backend. A public proof-of-concept exploit is available.

## Impact

An unauthenticated remote attacker can gain unauthorized control over sensitive infrastructure settings and interact with the connected Mnestix AAS Generator backend, potentially leading to unauthorized data manipulation or service disruption.

## Recommendation

* Immediately upgrade Eclipse Mnestix Browser to version 2.3.0 or later to remediate the authorization bypass.
* Audit access logs for the Mnestix Browser and the associated AAS Generator backend for requests originating from unexpected or unauthorized network segments.
* Restrict network access to the Mnestix Browser and AAS Generator components using firewall or ingress rules to ensure they are not exposed to untrusted networks until patched.

objects.name: Krill: Cryptographic session token vulnerability (CVE-2026-109140)
objects.description: Krill contains a vulnerability where login-session tokens are encrypted with a nonce built from a counter. This counter resets to 0 on every Krill restart, leading to the reuse of the same (key, nonce) pair after each restart.

objects.name: VOLTA-AUTODOXER Infostealer Leverages LLMs for Victim Data Prioritization
objects.description:
## Overview

VOLTA-AUTODOXER (aka VOLTA) is a Windows-based infostealer designed to offload data triage tasks to Large Language Models (LLMs). The malware harvests a wide array of sensitive data, including browser credentials, cookies, payment information, cryptocurrency wallet seeds, and session tokens for platforms like Discord, Telegram, and Steam. After collection, it serializes this data into an "evidence bundle" and routes it through the OpenRouter API to AI models - specifically Anthropic’s Claude, Moonshot AI’s Kimi, or Google’s Gemini - to generate a prioritized dossier on the victim, including a "WHAT THEY'RE WORTH" monetization assessment. Data exfiltration occurs in three stages via the Telegram messaging platform.

## Attack Chain

1. Initial infection and execution of the VOLTA-AUTODOXER binary on the Windows host.
2. Harvesting of local credentials, session tokens, and configuration files from web browsers, Outlook, Slack, and cloud-provider keys.
3. Enrichment of the stolen dataset by searching local Gmail caches for purchase receipts (e.g., Amazon, DoorDash, Uber Eats).
4. Serialization of the collected artifacts into a structured evidence bundle.
5. Transmission of the evidence bundle to an AI-model API (OpenRouter) using a system prompt designed to force the model into the role of a forensic intelligence analyst.
6. Exfiltration of the raw data, LLM-generated assessment, and enrichment evidence to the operator via Telegram.

## Impact

VOLTA enables operators to move beyond raw data collection to actionable, prioritized targeting. The use of AI for dossier generation provides immediate assessment of a victim's financial worth and security posture, which can significantly accelerate the effectiveness of subsequent phases like ransomware deployment or identity theft.

## Recommendation

- Monitor for unauthorized or suspicious outbound traffic to the OpenRouter API domain and Telegram API endpoints.
- Audit and restrict the use of unauthorized AI API keys or environment variables (e.g., OPENAI_API_KEY, though VOLTA uses OpenRouter, similar LLMjacking patterns apply) within enterprise environments.
- Implement endpoint detection and response (EDR) rules to monitor for common stealer behaviors: bulk file access in browser/application profiles, unusual process spawning, and connections to messaging-based C2 services.
- Enforce policies to prevent the storage of plaintext credentials or long-lived session tokens on local disk.

objects.name: AdminNeo: Cookie attribute injection via X-Forwarded-Prefix (CVE-2026-96631)
objects.description:
## Overview

AdminNeo versions 4.6.0 through 5.5.0 are vulnerable to cookie attribute injection via the `X-Forwarded-Prefix` HTTP header. The application fails to sanitize this user-supplied header before concatenating it into the `REQUEST_URI` and subsequently using it to construct `Set-Cookie` response headers. An attacker can inject arbitrary cookie attributes, such as `Domain`, `Path`, and `SameSite`, which are then parsed and executed by the victim's browser. This flaw impacts the `neo_sid` (session ID) and `neo_key` (database password encryption key) cookies. 

This issue is tracked as CVE-2026-96631.

## Impact

Successful exploitation allows for session hijacking of the `neo_sid` cookie and potential theft of the `neo_key` cookie, which is used to encrypt database credentials. An attacker can force the browser to send these cookies to an attacker-controlled domain by injecting a `Domain` attribute (e.g., `Domain=.evil.com`).

## Recommendation

- Upgrade to AdminNeo version 5.5.1 or later immediately.
- If immediate patching is not possible, modify the reverse proxy configuration to strip the `X-Forwarded-Prefix` header from client requests or force it to a static, trusted value.
- Implement a WAF rule to block HTTP requests containing semicolons or other metacharacters in the `X-Forwarded-Prefix` header.

objects.name: Redmine: Multiple security vulnerabilities
objects.description:
## Overview

Multiple vulnerabilities have been identified in Redmine that may permit remote exploitation. These issues include cross-site scripting (XSS), security policy bypasses, and denial-of-service (DoS) conditions. The CERT-FR advisory references security patches issued by the Redmine project on November 2, 2026.

## Recommendation

- Upgrade Redmine to version 6.0.12, 6.1.6, 7.0.3, or later as specified in the official Redmine security advisories.
- Review the Redmine security advisories page for specific patching instructions and version compatibility.

objects.name: Prefab UI: Arbitrary code execution via Generative UI sandbox (CVE-2026-120338)
objects.description: The Prefab UI Generative UI feature utilizes a Deno subprocess to execute Pyodide-based Python code. In versions 0.14.0 through 0.20.2, this subprocess is initiated with unrestricted `--allow-read`, `--allow-write`, and `--allow-net` permissions. Because the Deno API remains available on the JavaScript global object, the Python sandbox can invoke privileged functions such as `Deno.readTextFileSync` and `Deno.writeTextFileSync`. An attacker providing code through the `generate_prefab_ui` tool can read/write files as the server OS user or achieve code execution persistence by creating `.pth` files in the server's virtual environment.

objects.name: Admin REST API: SQL injection in administrative interface (CVE-2026-2613)
objects.description:
## Overview
CVE-2026-2613 is a SQL injection vulnerability in the Admin REST API. The API fails to adequately sanitize user-supplied input before incorporating it into SQL statements. Exploitation requires administrator privileges, allowing an attacker to execute blind SQL injection attacks to infer database contents or impact database service availability.

## Impact
Successful exploitation allows for unauthorized database information disclosure and potential service disruption by manipulating SQL query structures.

## Recommendation
- Inventory systems utilizing the Admin REST API to assess exposure.
- Prioritize application-level patching or vendor-issued updates to the Admin REST API to resolve input sanitization deficiencies.
- Review and restrict administrative access, as the vulnerability requires existing administrative privileges to exploit.
- Enable database query logging to detect anomalous query structures originating from the API service account.

objects.name: Flowise: Authenticated remote code execution
objects.description:
## Overview

A critical vulnerability has been identified in Flowise that enables an authenticated remote attacker to execute arbitrary code within the context of the service. The vulnerability stems from an insecure implementation that permits the bypass of existing security controls. As of this report, the vulnerability remains unpatched.

## Impact

An attacker successfully exploiting this vulnerability gains the ability to execute arbitrary code with the same privileges as the underlying Flowise service, potentially leading to full application compromise, data exfiltration, or further lateral movement within the environment.

## Recommendation

- Inventory all internet-facing or internal instances of Flowise within the infrastructure.
- Implement strict network segmentation to limit access to the Flowise management interface to trusted administrative subnets only.
- Monitor logs for unusual authentication activity followed by service-level process execution.
- Follow the vendor communication channels and prioritize the application of security updates once a patch is released.

objects.name: Product Gallery Slider & Additional Variation Images for WooCommerce: Privilege Escalation (CVE-2026-120318)
objects.description:
## Overview
The Product Gallery Slider & Additional Variation Images for WooCommerce plugin (versions prior to 2.3.26) contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the Codestar framework (CSF) component. Authenticated users with the Shop Manager role can access specific AJAX actions (`csf-export`, `csf-import`, `csf-reset`). By obtaining the `csf_backup_nonce` from the settings page, these users can interact with these actions to manipulate arbitrary WordPress options. An attacker can overwrite the `wp_user_roles` option, effectively granting themselves administrative privileges.

## Impact
Successful exploitation allows a Shop Manager to escalate their privileges to administrator. This provides full control over the WordPress instance, including the ability to install plugins, modify site content, and access sensitive database information.

## Recommendation
- Update the "Product Gallery Slider & Additional Variation Images for WooCommerce" plugin to version 2.3.26 or later immediately.
- Audit WordPress user roles to identify any accounts with unexpected administrative permissions.
- Audit WordPress site options for unauthorized modifications, particularly the `wp_user_roles` option.

objects.name: Amazon Virtual Engineering Workbench: Arbitrary code execution via template engine (CVE-2026-119085)
objects.description:
## Overview
Amazon Virtual Engineering Workbench (VEW) contains a vulnerability (CVE-2026-119085) in the template engine used within its publishing component. The flaw allows a remote authenticated user to supply a crafted CloudFormation template body containing malicious template engine directives through the product versioning API. Successful exploitation results in arbitrary code execution with the permissions of the publishing Lambda function's IAM role, potentially enabling unauthorized access to data and resources across all tenant projects.

## Impact
Successful exploitation allows for arbitrary code execution with the privileges of the AWS Lambda IAM role associated with the publishing component. This may result in unauthorized access, modification, or exfiltration of sensitive data and resources across all tenant projects within the affected environment.

## Recommendation
- Upgrade the Amazon Virtual Engineering Workbench deployment immediately by redeploying from the latest version available in the awslabs/virtual-engineering-workbench repository.
- Review IAM permissions associated with the publishing Lambda function to ensure the principle of least privilege is applied, limiting the impact of potential code execution.
- Audit logs for the product versioning API for requests containing unusual CloudFormation template bodies or template engine directive patterns.

objects.name: Kamailio: Stack-based buffer overflow in ims_qos_npn module (CVE-2026-106804)
objects.description:
## Overview
A stack-based buffer overflow vulnerability exists in Kamailio versions 6.1.3 and 6.1.4 within the ims_qos_npn module. The function w_rx_aar_register() copies the host field from a SIP Via header into a fixed 46-byte stack buffer without performing adequate length validation. An unauthenticated, remote attacker can trigger this vulnerability by sending a specially crafted SIP REGISTER request to the server.

## Impact
The primary observed impact is application instability and process termination, resulting in a denial-of-service condition for the affected Kamailio instance. While the vulnerability involves a stack-based buffer overflow, the report identifies the outcome as denial of service.

## Recommendation
- Inventory all Kamailio instances to identify deployments running versions 6.1.3 or 6.1.4.
- Monitor logs for malformed SIP traffic targeting the ims_qos_npn module.
- Upgrade affected Kamailio instances to a version where this vulnerability is remediated once a patch is available from the vendor.

objects.name: Zohocorp ManageEngine Log360 and EventLog Analyzer authentication bypass (CVE-2026-16900)
objects.description: Zohocorp ManageEngine Log360 and EventLog Analyzer versions 13071 and below are vulnerable to an authentication bypass in local collector registration. This allows an unauthenticated actor to register a local collector by sending a specially crafted registration request.

objects.name: XunRuiCMS: Remote code injection in Email Template Rendering (CVE-2026-120348)
objects.description: A vulnerability exists in dayrui XunRuiCMS up to 4.7.4. The function _get_tpl_content in dayrui/Fcms/Library/Notice.php (Email Template Rendering component) is susceptible to code injection. The attack can be initiated remotely. Public exploit code is available. The vendor was contacted but did not respond. The CVSS v3.1 base score is 7.3.

objects.name: Beta9: Sandbox escape via volume mount path traversal (CVE-2026-120308)
objects.description:
## Overview
A path traversal vulnerability exists in Beta9 gateway and worker components where volume identifiers are not validated for ownership or path constraints. By providing a volume identifier containing parent-directory traversal sequences, an authenticated tenant can cause the worker to bind-mount directories from the host filesystem into their sandbox. This grants read/write access to worker files and data belonging to other tenants. This vulnerability is confirmed in gateway version 0.1.769 and worker version 0.1.745.

## Impact
A tenant with a workspace token can perform unauthorized read and write operations on the underlying worker filesystem, potentially resulting in cross-tenant data exposure and host system compromise.

## Recommendation
Patch all Beta9 deployments by upgrading the gateway component to version 0.1.776 or later and the worker component to version 0.1.756 or later. These versions implement strict validation of volume identifiers and ownership checks.

objects.name: ZohoCorp ManageEngine Key Manager Plus: Input validation vulnerability (CVE-2026-77691)
objects.description:
## Overview

CVE-2026-77691 identifies a vulnerability in ZohoCorp ManageEngine Key Manager Plus versions before 7151. The vulnerability allows authenticated users to enter malicious input when configuring a Microsoft CA.

objects.name: Pjsip: Heap out-of-bounds read in DNS parser (CVE-2026-32945)
objects.description:
## Overview
CVE-2026-32945 is a heap-based out-of-bounds (OOB) read vulnerability affecting Pjsip (pjproject) versions 2.16 and earlier. The flaw resides in the DNS compression pointer parsing logic within `get_name_len()` and `get_name()` in `dns.c`. An attacker can trigger a crash in any application utilizing this library (including Asterisk and FreeSWITCH) by responding to a DNS query with a crafted 20-byte packet where the compression pointer marker (0xC0) is the final byte, causing an out-of-bounds memory read.

## Impact
The vulnerability results in a remote denial-of-service (DoS) condition, crashing the Pjsip-based application. No remote code execution has been documented, but public proof-of-concept code is available to trigger the crash.

## Recommendation
- Upgrade all deployments utilizing the Pjsip library to version 2.17 or later immediately.
- Patching requires an update to the core library; ensure applications linked against `libpjproject` are recompiled or updated with the fixed library version (commit 5311aee).
- Review network configurations for VOIP infrastructure; ensure DNS resolution is restricted to trusted, internal, or hardened recursive resolvers to mitigate the risk of rogue DNS response delivery.

objects.name: Network-AI: Path traversal in InputSanitizer (CVE-2026-120313)
objects.description:
## Overview
Network-AI versions prior to 5.15.5 are susceptible to a path traversal vulnerability located in the InputSanitizer.sanitizePath() function. The vulnerability arises from an unanchored "startsWith" check used during input validation. By providing a sibling-directory path that shares a string prefix with the intended base directory, an attacker can bypass these checks to access, list, or write files outside of the configured sandbox.

## Impact
Unauthorized access allows attackers to read, list, or write files on the host filesystem that are outside of the restricted sandbox directory.

## Recommendation
- Upgrade Network-AI to version 5.15.5 or later.
- Implement strict input validation or use established path-canonicalization libraries that do not rely on unanchored prefix comparisons for path isolation.
- Audit file system access logs for operations targeting directories outside of the designated application storage path.

objects.name: WAVLINK WL-WN579A3-A: Remote OS command injection (CVE-2026-120195)
objects.description:

The vulnerability is located in the `set_wzdgwMesh` function within `/cgi-bin/adm.cgi` of the Initial Setup Wizard. Manipulation of the `wlan_ssid` argument leads to OS command injection. objects.name: Easy Digital Downloads: Authentication bypass in PayPal checkout (CVE-2026-120538)
objects.description:
## Overview

The Easy Digital Downloads (EDD) plugin for WordPress contains an authentication bypass vulnerability (CVE-2026-120538) affecting versions 3.7.2 and earlier. During guest checkout via PayPal, the plugin incorrectly trusts the provided email address to associate a guest order with an existing WordPress user account. The function `edd_get_purchase_form_user()` binds the order to an existing user if the provided email matches, and `PurchaseUser::maybe_log_in_after_capture()` subsequently calls `wp_set_auth_cookie()` to grant an authenticated session to that user. An unauthenticated attacker can exploit this by using a target administrator's email address during the PayPal purchase flow.

## Attack Chain

1. Attacker initiates a guest checkout session within the WordPress site using the target administrator's email address.
2. The site application executes `edd_get_purchase_form_user()`, which identifies a match for the administrator's email in the WordPress user table.
3. The order's `user_id` is updated to reflect the matched administrator's ID.
4. The attacker completes the PayPal checkout process.
5. The `PurchaseUser::maybe_log_in_after_capture()` function processes the payment capture.
6. The plugin retrieves the user by the supplied email and validates the `user_id` match.
7. The system automatically issues an authentication cookie for the administrator account via `wp_set_auth_cookie()`.

## Impact

Successful exploitation results in full administrative account takeover of the WordPress site.

## Recommendation

* Patch the Easy Digital Downloads plugin immediately. Upgrade to a version beyond 3.7.2.
* Audit WordPress user session logs for anomalous login activity originating from recent PayPal checkout events.
* Monitor for unexpected creation of administrative accounts or changes to existing user privileges.

objects.name: Industrial Refrigeration Controller Unauthorized Access and Temperature Tampering
objects.description:
## Overview
Multiple European supermarket chains in Belgium, Sweden, Ireland, the Netherlands, Finland, Italy, Portugal, and Estonia have reported targeted attacks on industrial refrigeration controllers. Attackers are gaining unauthorized access to internet-reachable management interfaces of Danfoss and Copeland/Dixell devices, forcing evaporators into defrost mode, which results in significant temperature increases and food loss. Experts confirm many targeted units are legacy, end-of-life devices lacking vendor patches. Initial findings indicate usage of publicly documented factory-default credentials to gain entry.

## Attack Chain
1. Reconnaissance: Attackers identify internet-exposed refrigeration management interfaces (e.g., Danfoss StoreView).
2. Initial Access: Attackers authenticate to the management interface using known factory-default credentials.
3. Execution: Attackers modify controller settings to force the refrigeration unit into an active defrost cycle.
4. Impact: The cooling mechanism is overridden, causing internal unit temperatures to rise (up to 50°C), resulting in spoiled food and potential fire hazards.

## Impact
Over 100 stores across Europe have been affected, including major retailers like Delhaize, Carrefour, and Spar. Reported impacts include massive food spoilage, financial losses for small and large grocers, and operational disruption to the regional food supply chain.

## Recommendation
- Identify and inventory all internet-facing refrigeration management systems (specifically Danfoss AK-SM, AK-SC series, and Copeland/Dixell XWEB systems).
- Immediately remove industrial refrigeration controllers from the public internet.
- Implement strict network segmentation and place controllers behind a secure VPN or firewall requiring multi-factor authentication for access.
- Audit all management interfaces for the use of default factory credentials and replace them with unique, strong passwords.
- For end-of-life units that cannot be patched, apply physical isolation or replace the controller with modern, supported hardware.

objects.name: BuddyPress XProfile Image Field: Arbitrary file deletion (CVE-2026-120518)
objects.description: The BuddyPress XProfile Image Field plugin for WordPress (up to and including 3.1.0) contains a vulnerability in the bpxp_image_field_update_on_user_activation() function. The plugin fails to validate visitor-supplied signup metadata, specifically when a zero-byte file is submitted with the 'field_N_hidden' parameter. This raw value is resolved against the document root upon activation, allowing unauthenticated attackers to delete arbitrary files on the server. Successful exploitation requires open registration and an image-type profile field on the signup form. Deletion of critical files, such as wp-config.php, can lead to remote code execution.

objects.name: GPU pdma: Local privilege escalation via use-after-free (CVE-2026-20559)
objects.description: CVE-2026-20559 is a vulnerability in the GPU pdma component involving memory corruption caused by a use-after-free condition. The vulnerability can lead to local privilege escalation. Exploitation requires user execution privileges but does not require user interaction. This issue is tracked under Issue ID MSV-9545 and addressed by Patch ID ALPS11365081.

objects.name: Tenable Nessus Plugin: Data Confidentiality Vulnerability (CVE-2026-119317)
objects.description:
## Overview

Tenable has released a security update to address a vulnerability in the Nessus Plugin. The flaw, tracked as CVE-2026-119317, allows an attacker to compromise the confidentiality of data processed or accessed by the plugin. Organizations using Tenable Nessus are advised to update their plugin sets to version #202610282338 or later.

## Impact

Successful exploitation of this vulnerability results in an unauthorized disclosure of information (compromise of data confidentiality). The specific nature of the exposed data depends on the configuration and environment in which the Nessus scanner is deployed.

## Recommendation

Update the Tenable Nessus Plugin set to version #202610282338 or higher immediately to mitigate the risk posed by CVE-2026-119317. Verify the plugin set version via the Nessus administration console or the Tenable vulnerability management platform.

objects.name: Zoho ManageEngine Log360 and EventLog Analyzer unauthorized access (CVE-2026-13594)
objects.description: CVE-2026-13594 affects Zoho ManageEngine Log360 and EventLog Analyzer versions 13062 and below. The vulnerability allows an adversary to gain unauthorized access to the product.

objects.name: Octo STS: Trust policy information disclosure (CVE-2026-105770)
objects.description:
## Overview

Octo STS versions before 0.11.2 are susceptible to an information disclosure flaw (CVE-2026-105770). The application inappropriately includes sensitive trust policy configuration fields - such as issuer, subject, audience patterns, and claim patterns - within 'PermissionDenied' error messages returned by the Exchange service. An unauthorized user possessing any validly signed OIDC token, including GitHub Actions tokens from attacker-controlled repositories, can trigger these errors to reveal internal security configurations, potentially including references to private repositories, branch names, environment settings, or cloud account identifiers. The vulnerability does not allow for token minting or security policy bypass.

## Impact

Successful exploitation allows an attacker to enumerate internal security architecture, mapping internal repositories, cloud accounts, and environment naming conventions. This information can be utilized for reconnaissance in further attacks against the organization's infrastructure.

## Recommendation

- Upgrade Octo STS to version 0.11.2 or later immediately to address the error handling flaw.
- Review internal trust policy configurations for any sensitive secrets or overly descriptive naming conventions that might have been disclosed if this vulnerability was exploited prior to patching.
